title: Pluto in Enhanced Color
explanation:
# Pluto's Hidden Rainbow

When NASA's New Horizons spacecraft zoomed past distant Pluto in 2015, it captured and enhanced color images revealing a surprisingly vibrant world with a youthful, geologically active surface—including a giant heart-shaped region made of two chemically distinct materials that scientists had never expected to find on such an ancient, frozen dwarf planet. By digitally amplifying subtle color differences that our eyes couldn't see, researchers turned raw data into a stunning portrait that acts like a map of Pluto's hidden geology, helping us understand what processes sculpted this tiny world at the edge of our Solar System.
